title: FIU lands Miami’s first on-campus quantum computer
key_facts: FIU signed with IonQ for a 256-qubit Superion 256 system
Expected to arrive by end of 2027
FIU must build a secure data centre first
Open to over 56,000 students and 1,200 faculty
Priority areas: energy and materials, cybersecurity, health
quote_evidence: The contract, signed on September 23 and publicly announced the following day
The financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
why_it_matters_hint: First university trapped-ion system in Florida.
